shared_elements: row of short vertical strokes along the hull (crew marks)
vertical mast-like or staff-like line rising from a figure/hull
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by profile boats rendered as a long hull carrying a dense row of short vertical crew strokes, an arbitrary and quite specific convention, and both combine these with small schematic stick-like human figures drawn in pure outline. They differ in composition and detail: A shows a single large ship with mast, rigging and a patterned sail filling the field in a framed, centred layout, while B scatters several small mastless crescent boats plus isolated figures and abstract signs irregularly across the surface.
